description: Provenance for the committed real-market daily OHLCV fixtures used by the quantitative-backtesting worked examples and real-market tests. These fixtures back reproducibility of the real-market falsification tests; this manifest pins them so an undetected fixture swap is caught by tests/test_real_market_data_provenance.py.
index: tz-naive DatetimeIndex, sorted ascending, date granularity

all_fixtures.raw_source_note: Fetched live from Yahoo Finance chart API (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/{symbol}?period1=...&period2=...&interval=1d&events=div,splits) via data_loader.fetch_ohlcv_yahoo on 2026-11-12, range 2020-01-01..2025-12-31. The fetch succeeded (HTTP 200 after bounded retry/backoff); the exact upstream response timestamp is not asserted here. The fixtures are committed real-market data, not synthetic, and are NOT evidence of strategy performance.

AAPL.csv.role: primary real-market strategy universe (also the `sample_ohlcv.csv` primary benchmark; byte-identical to it)

MSFT.csv.role: distinct real-market asset fixture (also the `sample_benchmark.csv` alternative buy-and-hold benchmark; byte-identical to it and to the untracked `AAPL.csv.bak`)

sample_ohlcv.csv.role: primary benchmark in falsifiable_hypothesis_example.py BENCHMARK_FILES; byte-identical to AAPL.csv (same universe as the AAPL strategy -- same-universe buy-and-hold comparison)

sample_benchmark.csv.role: alternative benchmark in falsifiable_hypothesis_example.py BENCHMARK_FILES; byte-identical to MSFT.csv (distinct-asset buy-and-hold comparison)

byte_identity.note: AAPL.csv.bak is a tracked, committed duplicate of MSFT.csv (byte-identical to it and to sample_benchmark.csv); it is not part of the provenance fixtures index and is not referenced by any test.
